text: Phase 4 external-evidence gate: after B3 and the synthetic B4 decomposition retain a configuration, freeze an external manifest for at least five labeled same-affine development pairs plus sub18. Record file and transform hashes, dimensions, spacing, orientation, affine matrices, optimization and evaluation roles, exact matcher/bridge/HalfFlow settings, runtime environment, and hardware. Fixed masks may define optimization support; moving masks, labels, and surfaces are evaluation-only. Run the same frozen oracle and matcher lanes without retuning and report per-pair CC, Dice, surface distance, TRE where available, determinant and folds, inverse/export error, support, runtime, and memory. ANTs is an engineering reference rather than ground truth. B0 remains open until these external inputs and receipts exist.
